profile.headline: Engineering Leader
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineering leader with deep expertise in backend development, distributed systems, and API design. Over 10 years of driving technical excellence, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring junior engineers. Proven track record of leading complex engineering initiatives, standardizing best practices, and delivering high-quality, scalable solutions. Passionate about fostering collaborative, inclusive teams and driving technical growth and innovation.
